summary: This profile outlines the coding conventions and best practices for the modernization of the legacy banking application to C#.

rules.rule: Use PascalCase for class names and camelCase for method names.
Use try-catch blocks to handle exceptions and log errors.
examples: try { /* code */ } catch (Exception ex) { /* log error */ }

lint_recommendations: Ensure all C# files pass the StyleCop analysis.
